system.description:
"We do not die today!" Your rage is a booming battle hymn. You are a frontline Berserker who wades into the fray, weaponizing your own pain and fury to shield allies and empower their strikes.

LEVEL 3

Battle Hymn.

While your Rage is active, allies in Burst 4 gain advantage on STR saves and saves against Frightened and Taunted.

Additionally, when you Rage, you can expend 1 Fury die and choose one verse below. Effects last until the start of your next turn and affect all allies in Burst 4 that start their turn in the area or enter it on their turn:

  • Verse of Violence. Allies next attack, spell or ability gains a bonus to damage, healing or temp HP applied equal to the expended die's roll.
  • Verse of Pride. Allies gain bonus Armor, 1 round, equal to the expended die's roll.
  • Verse of Survival. Allies gain temp HP equal to half the expended die's roll.

Storyteller.

You can use your STR instead of WIL when telling tales of conquests, victories, battles or other Berserker things.

LEVEL 7

Boltering Howl.

Reaction: When an ally in Reach 4 is attacked. You may use That All You Got?! affecting that ally instead of yourself.

LEVEL 11

Saga of Battles.

You can expend up to 2 Fury Die when you use Battle Hymn choosing the same or different verses. Additionally while your Rage is active, allies that start their turn in Burst 4 gain +2 speed.

LEVEL 15

Warrior Poet.

1/turn, whenever an ally in the area of your Battle Hymn deals damage, you can roll a Fury Die.

Savage Arsenal

Thunderous Bellow. When you Rage, enemies in Burst 1 take STR Thunder damage and are pushed 1 space away if they are Large or smaller.

War Chant. While Raging, when you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a Fury Die to ignore the Rushed Attack penalty.

Brothers in Blood. Whenever you gain a Wound, you can bellow a rallying cry. One ally in Range 4 can immediately Move for free and gains STR temp HP, 1 round.

Deafening Rebuke. Reaction: When you expend Fury Dice for That all you got?!, if the attacker is within Range 4, they take Thunder damage equal to the highest die rolled.
